review_evidence: The README describes a formalization programme covering diffeological spaces, smooth spaces, Frölicher spaces, manifolds/orbifolds, tangent spaces, sites, sheaves, cohesion, and categorical limits/colimits.
The 41 formal-source files contain hundreds of theorem/lemma/example declarations; representative lemmas in DSmoothMap include ext, coe_injective, coe_mk, coe_id, and coe_const.
The project develops reusable definitions and proofs in topology, category theory, and differential geometry and is directly within the corpus mathematical-prior-art invariant.
summary: Retain lean-catdg: it is a large mathematical formalization of categorical differential geometry, especially diffeological and smooth spaces and cohesion.
